writing.target: This house is one century old.
The emperor lived in a big palace.
In the past, people used to|Nowadays,|My grandparents used to

text_en: Life a hundred years ago was very different from life nowadays.
Most people lived in villages and worked on farms.
There was no electricity in many homes, so people used candles and oil lamps.
Children used to walk a long way to school, and some children didn't go to school at all.
People travelled by horse, by cart or on foot.
There were no televisions or computers.
In the evening, families used to sit together and tell stories.
Although life was simple, it was often difficult.
What do you think was better in the past?
